article.title: USA votes against entire world, opposing equal representation of Africa, as it pushes to revive colonialism
article.author: Editor
article.content: The U.S. was the only country to oppose a UN resolution replacing a colonial world map from year 1569, which misrepresents Africa’s size. This is part of the Trump admin’s overt attempt to revive colonialism. The post USA votes against entire world, opposing equal representation of Africa, as it pushes to revive colonialism appeared first on MR Online .
